## Publication interpretation

The emissions path is no longer a linear prescription: it is produced by a reduced-form sectoral capital-turnover and investment-allocation screen. The reference case is calibrated to the IEA NZE 2035 energy-related CO2 anchor and a 2050 residual objective, so it is a conditional transition reference rather than a forecast. Official calibrated FaIR/OSCAR, gridded land/water and real-weather regional power-system validation remain required before treating a precise restoration date as an Earth-system prediction.
